Impeccable-uxui v1.0.0—Initial release focused on design context and bold, anti-generic frontend direction.

- Introduces a structured protocol for gathering essential design context before any UI/UX task.
- Provides detailed guidelines and anti-patterns across 7 core design domains: typography, color, space, motion, interaction, responsive design, UX writing.
- Emphasizes avoiding generic template aesthetics through curated references, clear conceptual direction, and bold visual choices.
- Includes 20+ steering commands for UI/UX auditing, critique, polishing, and more.
- Highlights design mistakes to avoid and best practices for memorable, production-grade frontend interfaces.

Full attribution to Paul Bakaus.
